**Francesca Biancani**

- Affiliated with the University of Bologna – one of the world’s oldest universities (S5, S30, S41).  
- Conducted a post‑doctoral fellowship in Cairo (IFAO/CEDEJ) and discusses the social aspects of sex in Egypt (S5, S30).  
- Authored works on female labour in colonial Egypt (S30, S32).  
- Reported as participating in the academic boycott of Israel between 2010‑2020 (S31, S65‑S69).  
- Co‑guest edited a 2023 essay/issue (Jerusalem Quarterly Issue 93) together with Maria Chiara Rioli (S53‑S60).  
- Attended the Italian‑English‑French conference “Italy and the Suez Canal” (2018‑2019; S43‑S47).  
- In an interview, cited Italian consular archives as a research source (S5).
